01 Services

Six scopes. One contract, one site team, one point of blame.

We self-perform structure, civil, and fit-out. MEP runs through in-house engineers with a fixed panel of specialist subcontractors.

01

General Contracting

Single-contract delivery from ground-breaking to hand-over, with our own site management and quality control.

Scope & capability 02

Civil Works

Piling, substructure, retaining systems, drainage, hardstand, and pavement for industrial and infrastructure sites.

Scope & capability 03

Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing

HVAC, power distribution, fire protection, and plumbing — designed, installed, commissioned, and handed over tested.

Scope & capability 04

Renovation

Structural upgrades and refurbishment in live buildings — phased, dust-controlled, and sequenced around your operations.

Scope & capability 05

Interior Fit-out

Office, retail, and healthcare fit-out with joinery from our own workshop in Cikupa. Turnkey including FF&E.

Scope & capability 06

Site Preparation

Clearing, cut-and-fill, soil improvement, temporary works, and access roads — the first 90 days handled properly.

03 How we work

Four stages, fixed reporting, no surprises at hand-over.

Weekly progress reporting with photographs, S-curve, and a rolling three-week look-ahead from day one.

Stage 01

Pre-construction

Buildability review, value engineering, programme, and a priced BoQ you can take to your board.

Stage 02

Mobilisation

Site establishment, permits, HSE induction, and the safety plan signed before a single machine moves.

Stage 03

Execution

Self-performed structure and civil, weekly S-curve reporting, and a fixed change-order process.

Stage 04

Hand-over

Commissioning, as-builts, O&M manuals, training, and a 24-month defect liability period.
